title: Frozen Config
prompt: Define a frozen dataclass Config(host='localhost', port=8080). Verify: two defaults are equal, and attempting to set config.port raises an exception (dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError).

tests.name: defaults are equal
tests.hint: Give host and port defaults in the class body.

tests.name: frozen cannot be mutated
tests.code:
import dataclasses
c = Config()
try:
    c.port = 9999
    failed = False
except dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError:
    failed = True
assert failed
